title: Giants extend Jameis Winston, Jon Runyan Jr. two years in stability moves to aid salary cap

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants extend Jameis Winston, Jon Runyan Jr. two years in stability moves to aid salary cap
sources.description: On a day when the Giants also extended backup quarterback Jameis Winston, they also ensured they’ll have another piece of their offensive line for another two seasons, too.
